rating_definitions.substantial: Independent specialist and primary-source collation plus precise physical interpretation, location, rights and current access sufficient for a chapter.
rating_definitions.developing: Specific locatable explanation from authoritative institutional/scholarly source, but independent or primary comparison incomplete.
rating_definitions.sparse: Abstract or short excerpt with unclear place chronology/material or no document-level detail.
rating_definitions.missing: Critical verified mapping, photo rights, public access or document absent.
